checked_classes: Spec violations — workflow matrix, fail-fast, command order, pinned OpenSpec invocation, Windows autocrlf-before-checkout, read-only permissions, triggers, and no secrets are all present in the diff
Correctness — GitHub Actions syntax and Windows run commands use forms supported by the runner shells; no inverted conditions or missing required steps were found
Regressions — the change only adds CI workflow/tests and updates the active OpenSpec change; no existing behavior in the packet is removed
Security — workflow permissions are restricted to contents: read and the diff contains no secrets references or credential literals
Constraint breaches — no added shell/Python files, shell:true, home/tmp literals, console logging in lib, forbidden service changes, or reference-repo edits appear in the diff
Silent failure — workflow run steps are separate commands without error-swallowing constructs, so non-zero exits fail the job as required
